problem.problem:
Anne is kind. Charlie is not big. Charlie is green. Erin is green. Erin is not kind. Harry is big. Harry is green. All big, green things are young. Big things are young. All red things are green. If something is kind then it is not red. All furry things are kind. If Harry is young then Harry is cold. If something is young and cold then it is furry.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Erin is furry.
raw_logic_programs:
Predicates:
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Furry($x, bool) ::: Is x furry?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?

Facts:
Kind(Anne, True) ::: Anne is kind.
Big(Charlie, False) ::: Charlie is not big.
Green(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is green.
Green(Erin, True) ::: Erin is green.
Kind(Erin, False) ::: Erin is not kind.
Big(Harry, True) ::: Harry is big.
Green(Harry, True) ::: Harry is green.

Rules:
Big($x, True) && Green($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: All big, green things are young.
Big($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: Big things are young.
Red($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: All red things are green.
Kind($x, True) >>> Red($x, False) ::: If something is kind then it is not red.
Furry($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: All furry things are kind.
Young(Harry, True) >>> Cold(Harry, True) ::: If Harry is young then Harry is cold.
Young($x, True) && Cold($x, True) >>> Furry($x, True) ::: If something is young and cold then it is furry.

Query:
Furry(Erin, True) ::: Erin is furry.
